(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent state prior to step (c) or (d).

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype, where said selection is performed using molecular analysis of the DNA obtained.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos after the selection process.
